basic_profile.bio: I'm a 23-year-old car enthusiast living in Austin, Texas. By day, I work as a mechanic at a local garage, specializing in classic cars. I enjoy spending my free time playing Unison League and researching true crime cases like the Summer Wells disappearance. I'm currently single, having recently ended a long-term relationship. I'm not a huge fan of social media, except for Reddit, where I can connect with like-minded individuals. You'll find me online mostly in the evenings, after work, and during the weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in automotive repair, having completed an apprenticeship right after high school. I further honed my skills through on-the-job experience and by participating in online forums and communities related to car restoration.
